$comment: GPU-5901 400 Hz ground power unit twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the data sheet, the cable data and the aircraft power limits; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.model: 2400 solid-state GPU, 90 kVA, mounted under the passenger boarding bridge
identification.description: 400 Hz ground power for a narrow-body contact stand: 3 x 115/200 V 400 Hz through a 28 m aircraft cable
identification.type: Fixed solid-state static frequency converter (not a diesel GPU), 50/60 Hz in, 400 Hz out
identification.cable: 28 m flexible 400 Hz aircraft cable on a cable coil, aircraft connector to ISO 461-1 style 6-pin plug
identification.location: Contact stand of a passenger terminal (generic airport)

rating.source: ITW GSE 2400 Compact data sheet (Rev C, June 2023): 90 kVA PF 0.8-1, 3 x 115/200 V, 400 Hz +/- 0.1 %, voltage regulation < 0.5 % (balanced and up to 30 % unbalanced load), total harmonic content < 2 % (typ. 1.5 %) per ISO 1540, overload 125 % for 600 s, operating up to +56 C.

efficiency.source: ITW GSE 2400 Compact data sheet (Rev C, June 2023): overall efficiency 0.94 at 35-90 kVA load PF 0.8, 0.90 at 25 kVA PF 0.8, no-load losses 2.2 kW, stand-by 65 W. The twin's loss model P_loss = P0 + k x S^2 is fitted to the 90 kVA point (k from 0.94) and checks the 25 kVA point.

cable.source: Length: 2400 Power Coil data sheet (24 m or 28 m usable cable). Resistance: assumption: typical value, replace with your cable data sheet (IEC 60228 class 5 copper 70 mm2 is 0.272 ohm/km at 20 C, raised for a warm conductor). Reactance at 400 Hz: assumption: typical value, replace with the cable maker's value (about 0.08 ohm/km at 50 Hz x 8; UFC 3-555-01N notes the 400 Hz reactance drop is about seven times the 60 Hz one).

aircraft_limits.source: UFC 3-555-01N (US DoD 400 Hz criteria, 2004, cancelled; quoted as design practice): MIL-STD-704 operating range 108-118 V inside the aircraft includes a 0-5 V internal drop, so the voltage at the aircraft connector should stay between 113 and 118 V; THD of the supply to the aircraft not above 5 %. Check the limits of your own aircraft types and of ISO 6858 / SAE ARP5015.

thermal.source: Heat-sink temperature rise per kW of converter loss (forced air): assumption: typical value, replace with the rise measured on your unit at commissioning.

wear.source: Output contactor electrical life and aircraft connector head life in mating cycles: assumption: typical value, replace with the contactor maker's AC-1 life curve and the connector maker's rated mating cycles.

apu.source: CO2 per kg of jet fuel: ICAO carbon emissions calculator methodology (3.16). APU fuel flow of a narrow-body APU at the gate: assumption: typical value, replace with the airline's APU fuel flow for your fleet (sources quote about 100 to 130 kg/h). Grid emission factor: assumption: typical value, replace with your utility's figure. Aircraft load at the gate (air conditioning by PCA, so electrical load only): assumption: typical value, replace with your measured load.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 20 times faster, so one turnaround (40 min on GPU, 10 min empty stand) takes 150 s of real time.

groups.Output: 400 Hz output at the GPU terminals

twin_model.limits_source: Regulation error, drop ratio, unbalance, loss excess, heat-sink residual and maximum: assumption, alert levels to tune on your unit. Connector 113-118 V and THD 5 %: design.aircraft_limits. Frequency +/- 0.1 % and THD 2 %: design.rating (data sheet).

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

connector_pin_wear.name: Aircraft connector pin worn or burnt
connector_pin_wear.symptoms: one phase drops more than the others at the aircraft, mating cycles past the head's life

cable_compensation_mismatch.name: Cable changed, drop compensation not updated
cable_compensation_mismatch.symptoms: all three phases drop more than the cable model, voltage at the aircraft low

voltage_regulation_fault.name: Output voltage regulation drift (sensing or control)
voltage_regulation_fault.symptoms: output below its setpoint, drop along the cable normal

output_filter_aging.name: Output filter capacitors aged
output_filter_aging.symptoms: voltage THD rises above the data sheet, then above 5 %

power_stage_losses.name: Power stage losses up (IGBT, transformer, connections)
power_stage_losses.symptoms: input power up for the same output, efficiency below the loss model

cooling_degraded.name: Cooling degraded (fan, clogged filter)
cooling_degraded.symptoms: heat sink hotter than the loss and the ambient explain

contactor_wear.name: Output contactor near the end of its life
contactor_wear.symptoms: operations counter past 90 % of the rated life

apu_left_running.name: APU left running while on ground power
apu_left_running.symptoms: aircraft on the GPU but its APU still runs: no fuel saved
